scope: Exact data member, length and SHA256 only. No execution, package, advisory or generic TZif clearance.
review: All bytes are accounted for by 345 contiguous TZif2/3 records, with two headers/data blocks each and bounded POSIX footers. Every transition ordering/index, local-time offset/DST/index, label byte/terminator/length, header count/reserved byte and footer grammar/range is checked. No leap/indicator extensions, opaque payloads, executable instructions, missing boundaries or trailing data.
limitations: This validates the data structure, not the correctness of civil-time rules or safety of downstream timezone implementations.
Only the no-leap, no-indicator TZif2/3 subset and M-rule footer grammar used by this exact data file are reviewed. Other dialects fail closed.
Original binary data is not committed; record hashes and typed semantic values are recorded.
